text:
arjun: Quick follow-up to the SDK surface RFC — we need to pick a cross-language consensus for transport + retry defaults before I update the proposal. Thoughts on what to standardize vs leave idiomatic per language?

maria: +1 we should be opinionated about safety (timeouts, retries) but let languages expose idiomatic APIs. i.e., default safest path but opt-in performance knobs.

jon: Practical tradeoff: a single behavioral contract (idempotency, retryable status codes, respect Retry-After) across SDKs, but implementation details (httpx vs requests, undici vs fetch) can vary. That keeps surface stable.

kevin: For Node: prefer native fetch when available + undici behind the scenes for older runtimes. Avoid pulling in axios because it muddies streaming and fetch semantics. Also we should expose a low-level transport hook for advanced users.

priya: For Python, recommend async-first using httpx for async and requests-based sync shim. We can offer a sync wrapper that uses anyio / trio later, but key is predictable timeouts and connection pooling.

li: Go should stick with net/http + context for cancellation. Provide a RequestOptions struct with Context, Timeout, and a Transport interface for testing/overrides. Keep retry middleware out of net/http core; implement as optional client decorator.

sam: Pagination ergonomics: Python -> iterator/generator + async iteration for async client. TS -> async iterable. Go -> channel-based helper and a paginator that returns (item, err) pairs. Aim for consistent naming: list_items, list_items_iter.

jon: Retry semantics proposal: default max_attempts=3, base_backoff=200ms, max_backoff=5s, use full-jitter, retry on 429, 503, 504, network errors. Respect Retry-After header and treat 501/415 as non-retryable. Non-idempotent endpoints should require explicit retry_on_body_failure flag or idempotency key.

kevin: Agree. Also: streaming endpoints (chat streaming, delta tokens) must not be automatically retried — streaming should surface partial progress and fail fast. For resumed streams we can consider token-level reconnect but that's a separate feature.

maria: Docs + migration: call out breaking changes if we change default attempts or backoff. Provide a compatibility layer: env var REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_RETRIES=true for one release cycle.

arjun: Example opt-in config idea (showing unified shape we can document across languages):

```json
{
  "retries": {
    "max_attempts": 3,
    "base_backoff_ms": 200,
    "max_backoff_ms": 5000,
    "jitter": "full",
    "retry_on": [429, 503, 504]
  },
  "timeouts": {
    "connect_ms": 1000,
    "read_ms": 30000
  },
  "transport_overrides": {
    "enabled": false
  }
}
```

li: That JSON is great for docs. In Go we'd map it to typed fields and validate. Important: timeouts must be per-request and cancellable via context.

priya: For Python async: default to short connect timeout and longer read timeout. Also expose a rate limiter hook so customers can plug in token bucket for bursty workloads.

kevin: Telemetry: every retry should emit an event (sdk.retry) with reason and attempt number. Keep payload small (code, duration). We can use existing telemetry pipeline.

sam: Pagination detail: return next_cursor as opaque string. Helper iterators should hide cursors but allow access to raw response for power users. Keep server-side cursor semantics unchanged.

jon: Testing: add cross-language integration tests that assert on retry behavior (simulate 503 then 200), pagination ordering, and no implicit retries for POST-like endpoints unless idempotency provided.

maria: Ops note: ensure rate-limits and per-tenant quotas are surfaced in SDK error codes so apps can fallback gracefully (use typed exceptions / error wrappers).

arjun: Sweet. Action items: kevin -> draft Node transport doc + fallback plan, priya -> python retry wrapper + tests, li -> Go transport interface + examples, jon -> update RFC with unified contract (retries/timeouts/pagination shape). I'll add migration flag and minimal compatibility notes. Please add short PRs into sdk-spec repo by EOW.

deploy-bot: RFC "sdk-transport-retries" updated by jon. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-spec/pull/412 :rocket:

arjun: Thanks all — if no objections by tomorrow I'll merge the RFC updates and start the SDK branch templates. :thumbsup:
